summary: Preset entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalPreset as CanonicalEntity preset PresetBody modeling the SillyTavern chat-completion prompt-manager family of ordered prompt blocks samplers and settings that RoleCall Marinara and Lumiverse dialects center on. Other ST preset subtypes context instruct sysprompt text-completion reasoning are out of scope. PresetAdapter is in the FormatAdapter union and four adapters read and write presets (SillyTavern RoleCall Marinara Lumiverse); no dedicated CLI preset subcommand, presets ride the generic inspect and convert commands, and Library and Workbench also author PresetBody directly. LiveBuild preview orders enabled blocks and counts tokens chars/4 without resolving macros groups or choices and never evals. How to read the field tables and Composition introduce generated tables. Prompt blocks and groups cover PresetPrompt verbatim ids markers placement and Groups. Sampler and generation settings System prompts templates and behavior API and media options Choices walkthrough Full composition Linked regex sets What rides escrow not a field and See also complete the map.

sections.title: How to read the field tables
sections.summary: Field tables are generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers lists wire formats verified for the shape even without a shipping adapter, or dash when untagged. Meaning explains purpose; blank cells are self-evident primitives. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: PresetBody requires name and prompts ordered manuscript plus twelve optional fields: groups and choices collections; samplers systemPrompts templates behavior apiOptions media generation settings sub-objects; description and enabled scalars; behaviorRefs link array. Grouping mirrors authoring not app storage. Full table lives under Full composition. Tables come from docs/generated/fields.preset.md.

sections.title: Prompt blocks and groups
sections.summary: PresetPrompt is one manuscript row mapping 1:1 to ST RC or Marinara sections. id is the VERBATIM source identifier never vaud-minted because order refs markers and isDefault key off it exempt from UUID regeneration. role is system user assistant. Per-block systemPrompt flag is not preset-level systemPrompts. placement follows position-picker law with relative in_chat append append_preset prepend_preset open union legality in platform-fields. marker structural placeholders use markerSlot. injectionDepth injectionOrder forbidOverrides injectionTrigger isDefault groupId wrapInXml xmlTagName extras complete the block. Groups child first-classes PresetGroup folders; ST derives divider ids from group id and escrows original divider only for imported ST groups so edits never invent escrow.

children.title: Groups
children.summary: PresetGroup is a category or folder of blocks first-class because Marinara groups and RC categories are authored. ST has no real groups and encodes dividers; the ST codec derives divider identifier deterministically from group id for vaud-authored groups and escrows original divider id only for imported ST groups so add rename move never invent escrow. Fields include id name optional content parentGroupId order enabled extras.

sections.title: Sampler and generation settings
sections.summary: Sampler and generation knobs are all optional: absent stays absent because round-trip forbids emitting values the source never had. Build applies defaults at compile time none stored on the entity. Surfaces match presets-core SamplerSettings and GenerationSettings. temperature topP topK topA minP penalties maxContext maxTokens promptPostProcessing contextMode tokens or messages and maxMessages when messages mode. Generation child covers seed completions maxContextUnlocked biasPreset.

children.title: Generation
children.summary: Generation settings include optional seed completions as number of completions presets-core n maxContextUnlocked boolean and biasPreset string. All optional following the same absent-stays-absent round-trip rule as samplers.

sections.title: System prompts, templates, and behavior
sections.summary: Three optional sub-objects assemble requests around the manuscript with every nested field optional too. systemPrompts carries always-on utility prompts impersonation newChat newGroupChat newExampleChat continueNudge groupNudge assistantPrefill assistantImpersonation. Templates child has worldInfoFormat scenarioFormat personalityFormat Handlebars-ish card field strings. Behavior child has wrapInQuotes namesBehavior as ST numeric enum kept verbatim sendIfEmpty continuePrefill continuePostfix message-assembly flags.

children.title: Templates
children.summary: PresetTemplates holds optional worldInfoFormat scenarioFormat and personalityFormat Handlebars-ish format strings for card fields matching presets-core TemplateFormats used when assembling requests around the manuscript.

children.title: Behavior
children.summary: PresetBehavior message-assembly flags: wrapInQuotes, namesBehavior as ST names_behavior numeric enum kept verbatim not decoded to a named union, sendIfEmpty, continuePrefill, and continuePostfix. All optional.

sections.title: API and media options
sections.summary: API and media options hold provider and request-level toggles as two optional sub-objects with every nested field optional too matching presets-core APIOptions and MediaSettings. apiOptions covers streamResponses for streaming replies, claudeUseSystemPrompt and useMakerSuiteSystemPrompt for provider system-prompt shapes, squashSystemMessages, functionCalling, showThoughts, reasoningEffort as a string dial, enableWebSearch, and requestImages. Media child covers imageInlining, inlineImageQuality string, and videoInlining for how media is embedded into provider requests. Absent fields stay absent under the round-trip law the same as samplers; nothing here is executed by the converter or LiveBuild preview.

children.title: Media
children.summary: PresetMedia optional imageInlining boolean inlineImageQuality string and videoInlining boolean control how images and video are inlined into provider requests for the preset.

sections.title: Choices walkthrough
sections.summary: PresetChoice unifies Marinara choiceBlock and RC ChoiceGroup: authored now run later when a run surface exists. Answers feed getvar key gate blocks via enablesPrompts or write scoped state via set. type one many toggle input with default shaped to match; options min placeholder suggestions separator randomPick sortOrder extras. Options child carries value enablesPrompts and set first-class so each source keeps its effect without dropping the others.

children.title: Options
children.summary: PresetChoiceOption has id label optional description Marinara value for the choice variable RC enablesPrompts block ids gated while selected and RC set scoped state writes. All three effects are first-class; a source using one leaves others empty rather than collapsing shapes.

sections.title: Full composition
sections.summary: PresetBody top shape: name description enabled shelf switch read as enabled not false so off presets skip export like off sets; prompts ordered real blocks never divider rows; groups categories; samplers systemPrompts templates behavior apiOptions media generation; choices walkthrough authored now run later; behaviorRefs linked regex ids. Dividers are never blocks; groups model structure.

sections.title: Linked regex sets
sections.summary: behaviorRefs is the preset counterpart of CharacterBody.behaviorRefs: it names standalone regex/script pieces by canonical id instead of copying their rules, so the set stays one editable piece shared by every preset that links it. The link is canonical; embedding is decided per format at export. SillyTavern and RoleCall carry rows inside the preset file under extensions.regex_scripts, so their adapters embed a linked set. Lumiverse attaches by preset_id on the script instead, and Marinara has no preset-level attachment at all, so nothing rides inside those files. Each adapter's embedRegex owns its answer, and emitPresetBundle reports a set that could not ride rather than dropping it silently.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Design principle: model what the editor or domain authors canonically; escrow pure source-wire fidelity no editor touches. groups and choices are canonical not escrow because Marinara and RC author them. Rides escrow: ST per-character prompt_order overrides, Marinara variable layer, original divider identifier for imported ST PresetGroup, and extras bags on prompt group and choice sealed leftovers. Does NOT ride escrow: groups and choices themselves first-classed.

sections.title: See also
sections.summary: Related authority is architecture.md for the canonical model escrow hub-and-spoke and the adapter contract. That contract currently excludes preset from the FormatAdapter union so no toCanonical fromCanonical pair ships yet while Library and Workbench still author PresetBody directly through createAndOpenPreset and PresetEditorView.
